summary: Tested Crew Roles picks feature (backend + mobile 390px UI) as Pro test_session_pro_1. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (Racing Roles migration placed after Safety & Emergency, idempotent after backend restart: still 13 items/1 Racing group; role_options ticked-only, no headings/'*', all roles when none ticked, not capped at 12; invite with roles create+cancel). UI: Crew Roles template list auto-added; '*' stripped; Skipper/Navigator/First Aider ticked by default; ticked rows have is-pick is-checked, blue (#1d4ed8) text, no line-through. Invite picker groups by heading with only ticked roles; label 'Planned voyage or race notes'; WhatsApp preview uses '*Planned voyage or race*'. Change available closes dialogs, opens Crew Roles with back-to-invite-bar; ticking Helm / unticking Navigator is reflected in reopened picker (Racing Roles: Helm, no Navigator). Dismiss hides bar and clears draft. EditRolesDialog shows grouped roles + 'Other roles' for assigned-but-unavailable roles. None ticked -> all 13 roles offered. Regression: normal list ticked item still line-through. ONE BUG: after Back to Invite crew, the email and picked roles are NOT restored (empty email, no chip selected); notes only come back because they were saved to the server.

minor.issue: role_options = ticked roles + roles already used by crew/invites (used roles appended), so it isn't strictly 'ticked-only'. Probably intended; frontend uses local roleGroups anyway.
Backend strips only '*' but frontend clean() also strips leading '1.'/'1)' numbering, so a numbered non-heading role would show differently in role_options vs the picker.

ui_bugs.component: InviteCrewDialog draft restore (Change available -> Back to Invite crew)
ui_bugs.issue: Email and picked roles are lost on return. Instrumented sessionStorage: the open effect reads mbp_invite_draft and removes it, then runs a SECOND time on reopen (InviteCrewDialog remounts inside the re-mounted CrewDialog DialogContent; React.StrictMode double-invokes effects on mount), and the second run finds null and resets email='' and roles=[]. Notes show up only because saveNotes() PUT them to voyage_notes first.

issues: Heading rows (1. Sailing, etc.) still have tick boxes. Ticking one does nothing for the roles offered, which may confuse users (minor).

action_items: Fix the invite draft restore in InviteCrewDialog.jsx: don't remove mbp_invite_draft inside the open effect, which can run more than once. For example: read the draft into a ref/state once and only remove it after it has been applied (guard with a useRef flag), remove it on send/close, or keep the draft in CrewDialog state and pass it as a prop. Then check that email, picked roles and notes all come back after Back to Invite crew.
critical_code_review_comments: InviteCrewDialog open effect is not idempotent (it reads and deletes sessionStorage), so it breaks under StrictMode/remounts. This is the root cause of the bug above.
BoatPrep BackToInviteBar onDismiss hardcodes 'mbp_invite_draft' instead of importing INVITE_DRAFT.
roleGroups(state) is recomputed on every BoatSwitcher render (cheap, but could be memoised).

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all checks pass except draft email/roles restore)

rca of the issue: Repro: open Invite crew, type qa-crew@example.com, pick Skipper, type notes, click Change available, then Back to Invite crew. The email is empty and no role is selected. Console instrumentation showed 'DRAFT get -> {...}', 'DRAFT remove', then 'DRAFT get -> null', 'DRAFT remove': the effect ran twice on reopen. Mitigation: make the draft read idempotent (ref guard, or delete the draft only after a successful restore/send).
